title: VTC Events — Hosts — List — payload
description: List an event's hosts, by entry: whom to ask about an event. Answered to every member who may see the event. The outer document members are owned by the framework — SPEC §6.3.

Response.title: VTC Events — Hosts — List — response payload
Response.description: The success response to a vtc/events/hosts/list/0.1 request. Carried in a Trust Task document whose type is https://trusttasks.org/spec/vtc/events/hosts/list/0.1#response.

hosts.description: Entries holding `vtc.events.manage` qualified to this event, its creator first while they host it. Holders of authority over the whole calendar are not listed.
